title: U.S. Gas Prices Continue to Rise
partialText: The price for a gallon of regular gasoline has jumped more than 20 cents this week. Diesel prices rose to their highest level since April 2024.

title: All3Media and Banijay, 2 Big Production Houses, to Merge
partialText: The deal between All3Media and Banijay will bring together the companies behind the “Peaky Blinders” and the “Traitors” franchises.

title: Bessent Says Global Tariffs Will Rise to 15% This Week
partialText: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent predicted that overall tariff rates, which fell after a Supreme Court ruling last month, would be back to previous levels within five months.

title: The High Stakes of Keeping the Strait of Hormuz Open
partialText: The U.S.-Israeli war with Iran has paralyzed the strait, a vital shipping lane for energy and commerce, putting global investors on edge.

title: Top Fed Official, Wary of Inflation, Calls for Extended Rate Pause
partialText: Beth M. Hammack, head of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, says it is too early to gauge the economic impact of the Iran war and backs holding interest rates steady for “quite some time.”

title: Paramount-Warner Deal Promises to Shake Up Streaming
partialText: The deal would put the combined company in the same league as Disney and Amazon. But Netflix and YouTube will still easily outrank everyone.

title: To Cut Housing Costs, Some States Are Easing Fire Safety Rules
partialText: Last year, six states eliminated a fire-safety code requiring apartment buildings taller than three stories to have at least two staircases. More states are exploring the move.

title: Fred VanVleet Was a Critic of the NBA Players’ Union. Now He’s Leading It.
partialText: Fred VanVleet, a league veteran, has plenty of headaches to deal with. Can he revive trust in the organization?

partialText: Markets in Europe and the United States appeared to stabilize after days of turmoil, but stocks in Asia fell sharply.

title: 9 Million Indians Live in the Persian Gulf. The Money They Send Home Is a Lifeline.
partialText: A huge number of Indians spend their lives hopping across the Arabian Sea — remitting billions of dollars a year, supporting their families and the Indian economy.

title: Vail Resorts Reduces the Price of Its Epic Pass for Gen Z Skiers
partialText: Seeming to acknowledge critics’ complaints about the high cost of snow sports, the company is cutting the price of its 2026-2027 Epic Passes for younger skiers and snowboarders.

title: Target to Spend Billions to Refresh Stores, and Hire More Workers
partialText: The new C.E.O. said the company would focus on home décor, apparel and pop culture trends in an effort to reverse years of sales declines.

title: How Anonymous Bettors Cashed In on the Iran Strike, Just Hours Before It Happened

title: Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch Provide Sustainable Recommendations
partialText: Seafood Watch, long a source of advice on sustainable choices, is working to get restaurants to adopt its color-coded recommendations.

title: War-Induced Inflation Spike Looms Over Europe’s Economic Recovery

partialText: President Trump has signaled that he is open to the idea of a prolonged military conflict with Iran. Investors are spooked by that scenario.

title: Travelers Stuck in Dubai Face ‘Chaos and Confusion’ Amid Flight Cancellations
